subject: Pilot decision path & procurement sprint — advocate readout
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@fresnohealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed procurement sprint

Hi Elena — great to connect today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align on the pilot decision path: 

Summary of call:
- Use case: batch clinical note summarization for revenue ops (throughput target ~100k tokens/day).
- Champion: you (Elena) — will advocate internally for a pilot.
- Risk areas flagged: data residency concerns, SOC2 evidence, and procurement SLA / legal redlines.
- Initial success metric: 20% reduction in clinician documentation time vs baseline over 30 days.

Immediate asks / decision owners we discussed:
1) Economic buyer: you mentioned CFO Mark Rivera — please confirm if Mark will need to sign the pilot commitment or just sign off after procurement.
2) Procurement: please introduce us to your procurement lead so we can send the draft SOW and standard terms.
3) Security: Tom Hsu (CISO) will want the security evidence pack and our data retention controls.

Proposed short sprint (timeline):
- Day 0–3: Procurement receives draft SOW + commercial summary.
- Day 3–7: Security review (we provide evidence checklist + one-pager).
- Day 7–14: Legal/Proc finalize minimal redlines and pilot go/no-go.

What we’ll deliver from Redwood: ROI one-pager for the economic buyer, a concise security evidence checklist, and a pilot SOW template. I’ve copied Ben from our team to put together the ROI and SOW drafts.

Next steps (can you confirm by EOD Monday?):
- Confirm who from procurement and legal should be on the thread.
- Confirm whether Mark Rivera (CFO) needs a separate finance ROI pack.

Thanks again — excited to move this forward.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

Attachments referenced: pilot-sow-template.pdf (draft SOW), security-evidence-checklist.xlsx (security checklist)
